verses.original: מֵפִ֛יץ עָלָ֥ה עַל־ פָּנַ֖יִךְ נָצ֣וֹר מְצֻרָ֑ה צַפֵּה־ דֶ֙רֶךְ֙ חַזֵּ֣ק מָתְנַ֔יִם אַמֵּ֥ץ מְאֹֽד׃ כֹּ֖חַ
verses.transliteration: mê·p̄îṣ ‘ā·lāh ‘al- pā·na·yiḵ nā·ṣō·wr mə·ṣu·rāh ṣap·pêh- ḏe·reḵ ḥaz·zêq mā·ṯə·na·yim ’am·mêṣ mə·’ōḏ kō·aḥ
verses.literal: One who scatters advances against you, [O Nineveh] Guard the fortress Watch the road Brace yourselves . . . Summon all your strength

verses.original: כִּ֣י יְהוָה֙ אֶת־ שָׁ֤ב גְּא֣וֹן יַעֲקֹ֔ב כִּגְא֖וֹן יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כִּ֤י בֹּֽקְקִ֔ים בְקָקוּם֙ שִׁחֵֽתוּ׃ וּזְמֹרֵיהֶ֖ם
verses.transliteration: kî Yah·weh ’eṯ- šāḇ gə·’ō·wn ya·‘ă·qōḇ kiḡ·’ō·wn yiś·rā·’êl kî bō·qə·qîm ḇə·qā·qūm ši·ḥê·ṯū ū·zə·mō·rê·hem
verses.literal: For the LORD - will restore the splendor of Jacob like the splendor of Israel though destroyers have laid them waste and ruined the branches of their vine

verses.original: מָגֵ֨ן גִּבֹּרֵ֜יהוּ מְאָדָּ֗ם אַנְשֵׁי־ חַ֙יִל֙ מְתֻלָּעִ֔ים פְּלָד֥וֹת הָרֶ֖כֶב בְּאֵשׁ־ בְּי֣וֹם הֲכִינ֑וֹ וְהַבְּרֹשִׁ֖ים הָרְעָֽלוּ׃
verses.transliteration: mā·ḡên gib·bō·rê·hū mə·’ād·dām ’an·šê- ḥa·yil mə·ṯul·lā·‘îm pə·lā·ḏō·wṯ hā·re·ḵeḇ bə·’êš- bə·yō·wm hă·ḵî·nōw wə·hab·bə·rō·šîm hā·rə·‘ā·lū
verses.literal: The shields of his mighty men are red the valiant warriors . . . are dressed in scarlet The fittings of the chariots flash like fire on the day they are prepared and the spears of cypress have been brandished

verses.original: הָרֶ֔כֶב יִתְהוֹלְל֣וּ בַּֽחוּצוֹת֙ יִֽשְׁתַּקְשְׁק֖וּן בָּרְחֹב֑וֹת מַרְאֵיהֶן֙ כַּלַּפִּידִ֔ם יְרוֹצֵֽצוּ׃ כַּבְּרָקִ֖ים
verses.transliteration: hā·re·ḵeḇ yiṯ·hō·wl·lū ba·ḥū·ṣō·wṯ yiš·taq·šə·qūn bā·rə·ḥō·ḇō·wṯ mar·’ê·hen kal·lap·pî·ḏim yə·rō·w·ṣê·ṣū kab·bə·rā·qîm
verses.literal: The chariots dash through the streets they rush around the plazas appearing like torches darting about like lightning

verses.original: יִזְכֹּר֙ אַדִּירָ֔יו יִכָּשְׁל֖וּ בַהֲלִכוֹתָם יְמַֽהֲרוּ֙ חֽוֹמָתָ֔הּ הַסֹּכֵֽךְ׃ וְהֻכַ֖ן
verses.transliteration: yiz·kōr ’ad·dî·rāw yik·kā·šə·lū ḇa·hă·li·ḵō·ṯå̄m yə·ma·hă·rū ḥō·w·mā·ṯāh has·sō·ḵêḵ wə·hu·ḵan
verses.literal: He summons his nobles they stumble as they advance They race to its wall the protective shield is set in place
The river gates are thrown open and the palace collapses

verses.original: וְהֻצַּ֖ב גֻּלְּתָ֣ה הֹֽעֲלָ֑תָה וְאַמְהֹתֶ֗יהָ מְנַֽהֲגוֹת֙ כְּק֣וֹל יוֹנִ֔ים מְתֹפְפֹ֖ת עַל־ לִבְבֵהֶֽן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·huṣ·ṣaḇ gul·lə·ṯāh hō·‘ă·lā·ṯāh wə·’am·hō·ṯe·hā mə·na·hă·ḡō·wṯ kə·qō·wl yō·w·nîm mə·ṯō·p̄ə·p̄ōṯ ‘al- liḇ·ḇê·hen
verses.literal: It is decreed that [the city] be exiled and carried away her maidservants moan like doves and beat upon their breasts

verses.original: וְנִינְוֵ֥ה כִבְרֵֽכַת־ מַ֖יִם הִ֑יא מִ֣ימֵי וְהֵ֣מָּה נָסִ֔ים עִמְד֥וּ עֲמֹ֖דוּ וְאֵ֥ין מַפְנֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nî·nə·wêh ḵiḇ·rê·ḵaṯ- ma·yim hî mî·mê wə·hêm·māh nā·sîm ‘im·ḏū ‘ă·mō·ḏū wə·’ên map̄·neh
verses.literal: Nineveh has been like a pool of water throughout her days but now it is draining away Stop Stop!” they cry but no one turns back

verses.original: בֹּ֥זּוּ כֶ֖סֶף בֹּ֣זּוּ זָהָ֑ב וְאֵ֥ין קֵ֙צֶה֙ לַתְּכוּנָ֔ה כָּבֹ֕ד מִכֹּ֖ל חֶמְדָּֽה׃ כְּלִ֥י
verses.transliteration: bōz·zū ḵe·sep̄ bōz·zū zā·hāḇ wə·’ên qê·ṣeh lat·tə·ḵū·nāh kā·ḇōḏ mik·kōl ḥem·dāh kə·lî
verses.literal: Plunder the silver Plunder the gold There is no end to the treasure an abundance of every precious thing

verses.original: בּוּקָ֥ה וּמְבוּקָ֖ה וּמְבֻלָּקָ֑ה וְלֵ֨ב נָמֵ֜ס בִּרְכַּ֗יִם וּפִ֣ק מָתְנַ֔יִם וְחַלְחָלָה֙ בְּכָל־ וּפְנֵ֥י כֻלָּ֖ם קִבְּצ֥וּ פָארֽוּר׃
verses.transliteration: bū·qāh ū·mə·ḇū·qāh ū·mə·ḇul·lā·qāh wə·lêḇ nā·mês bir·ka·yim ū·p̄iq mā·ṯə·na·yim wə·ḥal·ḥā·lāh bə·ḵāl ū·p̄ə·nê ḵul·lām qib·bə·ṣū p̄ā·rūr
verses.literal: She is emptied Yes , she is desolate and laid waste Hearts melt knees knock bodies tremble and every face . . . grows pale . . .

verses.original: אַיֵּה֙ אֲרָי֔וֹת מְע֣וֹן וּמִרְעֶ֥ה ה֖וּא לַכְּפִרִ֑ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר אַרְיֵ֨ה לָבִ֥יא שָׁ֛ם הָלַךְ֩ אַרְיֵ֖ה גּ֥וּר וְאֵ֥ין מַחֲרִֽיד׃
verses.transliteration: ’ay·yêh ’ă·rā·yō·wṯ mə·‘ō·wn ū·mir·‘eh hū lak·kə·p̄i·rîm ’ă·šer ’ar·yêh lā·ḇî šām hā·laḵ ’ar·yêh gūr wə·’ên ma·ḥă·rîḏ
verses.literal: Where is the lions’ lair or the feeding ground . . . of the young lions where the lion and lioness . . . prowled with [their] cubs with nothing to frighten them away

verses.original: אַרְיֵ֤ה טֹרֵף֙ בְּדֵ֣י גֹֽרוֹתָ֔יו וּמְחַנֵּ֖ק לְלִבְאֹתָ֑יו וַיְמַלֵּא־ חֹרָ֔יו טֶ֣רֶף וּמְעֹֽנֹתָ֖יו טְרֵפָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’ar·yêh ṭō·rêp̄ bə·ḏê ḡō·rō·w·ṯāw ū·mə·ḥan·nêq lə·liḇ·’ō·ṯāw way·mal·lê- ḥō·rāw ṭe·rep̄ ū·mə·‘ō·nō·ṯāw ṭə·rê·p̄āh
verses.literal: The lion mauled enough for its cubs and strangled prey for the lioness It filled its dens with the kill and its lairs with mauled prey

verses.original: הִנְנִ֣י אֵלַ֗יִךְ נְאֻם֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת וְהִבְעַרְתִּ֤י רִכְבָּ֔הּ בֶֽעָשָׁן֙ חָ֑רֶב תֹּ֣אכַל וּכְפִירַ֖יִךְ וְהִכְרַתִּ֤י טַרְפֵּ֔ךְ מֵאֶ֙רֶץ֙ ק֥וֹל מַלְאָכֵֽכֵה׃ס וְלֹֽא־ יִשָּׁמַ֥ע ע֖וֹד
verses.transliteration: hin·nî ’ê·la·yiḵ nə·’um Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ wə·hiḇ·‘ar·tî riḵ·bāh ḇe·‘ā·šān ḥā·reḇ tō·ḵal ū·ḵə·p̄î·ra·yiḵ wə·hiḵ·rat·tî ṭar·pêḵ mê·’e·reṣ qō·wl mal·’ā·ḵê·ḵêh wə·lō- yiš·šā·ma‘ ‘ō·wḏ
verses.literal: Behold I am against you declares the LORD of Hosts I will reduce your chariots to cinders and the sword will devour your young lions I will cut off your prey from the earth and the voices of your messengers will no longer be heard -
